column4: hand per-site StepObs lemma: the region is on the block-reflection decode table — use #derive_case/block_facts (model: Vsa/Sim/EnvDefSeg.lean; 58 hand lines became 14)

maxHeartbeats above the 8000000 standard: a timeout means the construction is wrong — fix with more abstraction (check ground literals first), never a budget raise (values at or below the standard are fine)
hand ABI-frame threading: framed variants are FREE — use FrameMeta (abiFrame_of_wrChain / memFrame_of_chain / bblocks_sound_framed, one decide per block)
per-callee framed re-derivation: before re-running a chain with a ghost conjunct, check FrameMeta metatheorems apply (they subsume ABI + footprint frames)
>12 stepObs_ references in one new file: this is a hand-threaded chain — use the seg/block-reflection layer (block_facts, #derive_case, chain_facts)

deep anonymous projection (4+ chain) into an ∃/∧ tower: state posts/entries as named-field `structure ... : Prop where` (model: FoundSt/GeomFacts/FrameCalc), or land ONE named destructuring lemma beside the landed tower and consume through it — never positional .2-chains

>8 existentials in one file suggests anonymous ∃/∧-tower post definitions: new posts/entries must be named-field structures (robust to reorder, self-documenting, cheap projections); if consuming landed towers, write the named destructurer once
conseq with an identity side: use Triple.dimap/lmap/rmap (TripleCat) — the profunctor action is the canonical adapter; adapter PAIRS should be one PredIso + transportPre/transportPost

multi-block whole-function assemblies must be GENERATED (scripts/gen_fn.py emits arms + fold and stamps its allow marker); hand-rolling block batteries beside gen_fn is the exponential path the layer exists to prevent

exec-arm → eval_expr child prefix reflected by hand: instantiate EvalChildArm (descriptor + Cert + Sem; model Vsa/Sim/rows/EvalChildArmIf.lean) — the dispatch, carrier, exit kit and normal-exit resume are generic; never re-derive them per arm

exec-arm → exec_stmt child prefix reflected by hand: instantiate StmtChildArm (descriptor + Cert + Sem; model Vsa/Sim/rows/ForLoopArms.lean) — the dispatch, carrier, exit kit, status routes, and exit heads are generic (Vsa/Sim/StmtChildArm.lean)

in-frame runtime-helper call (value_null/env_define/env_new) prefix reflected by hand: instantiate HelperCall (descriptor + Cert + facts; model Vsa/Sim/rows/Field_hSRetNullClosed.lean, rows/EnvDefineCall.lean) — parking, the callee adapter, the return, and the continuation kit are generic (Vsa/Sim/HelperCall.lean)

string-comparison seam reflected by hand: instantiate StrCmpCell (descriptor + Cert; model Vsa/Sim/rows/StrCmpCellInstances.lean) — the dispatch, the strcmp seam, the sign tail, the value_bool box, and the field supplier are generic (Vsa/Sim/StrCmpSeam.lean, Vsa/Sim/StrCmpCell.lean)

hand-rolled allocator ledger field: the allocator's runs and footprint discipline are RUN-GLOBAL — take ONE `AllocLedger` (Vsa/Sim/AllocLedger.lean) and project it (`EnvNewLedger.of_alloc`, `EnvDefineUpdateLedger.of_alloc`, `EnvDefineMissLedger.of_alloc`); the entry-side separation facts are `HeapOwned.entryOff`/`.ownedOff` (Vsa/Sim/AllocOff.lean), never re-derived per site
